_comment: Nodes or exact spans the extractor attributed to a CHARACTER but which are narration. Use nodes:[n,...] for a whole node and spans:[{node:n,text:'exact text'}] for narration embedded in a mixed node. Applied by apply_narration_fixes.py <game>, which adds {{GM}} markers inside app/data/<game>/characters.json. build_line_segments.py then routes those spans to the narrator and follows the narrator's casting - unlike a per-line voice override, which would pin one voice and silently stop tracking a recast. Idempotent: text already wrapped is skipped.

dragonfall.reason: Both nodes are the player examining the body. Node 23 ('The memories of Monika's violent convulsions...') and node 28 ('Peering at the corpse's face, you confirm what you'd already suspected...') are addressed to 'you' and describe the corpse in the third person - Green Winters is dead on the floor in this scene and says nothing. The convo binds to his actor slot, which is why they landed on him. These are the only two nodes he has in this conversation.
